0022600040.text: The Warriors (8-4, sixth in the West and 2.5 games behind the Pacific-leading... no, second in the Pacific) are coming off a loss and have won eight of their last ten, while the Spurs (10-2, first in the Southwest) are on a 10-game winning streak and have gone 6-0 on the road. Golden State is missing Brandon Williams (hamstring), Gary Payton II (knee inflammation), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Stephen Curry is day-to-day with abdominal soreness and is a game-time decision. San Antonio is without Devin Vassell (groin), Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery), and Tobias Harris (calf strain), and the teams have not met yet this season after splitting their 2025-26 series 2-2, with the Warriors losing the most recent meeting 127-113 in San Francisco on April 1, 2026.
